jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description Social Science broad-based is designed for students who are undecided about their majors or would like to have more time to explore different options. This programme provides applicants with the option of entering the Faculty of Social Science without committing to a particular Major programme. Students follow a common study plan in their first year, after which they will declare any one of the following Major programmes without any competition or quota imposed to continue their studies in Years 2-4. Architectural Studies Economics Geography and Resource Management Urban Studies Government and Public Administration Journalism and Communication Global Communication Psychology Sociology Global Studies Data Science and Policy Studies Global Economics and Finance By taking different Major foundation courses in the first year, students gain first-hand experience of a variety of Social Science disciplines while at the same time seek counselling and academic advice from teachers and senior students. After some exploration in the first year of study, students can freely* choose their Majors based on their academic strength, interest and career aspirations. *Admission to certain programme(s) would be subject to relevant conditions.

cuhkAdmission.introduction: Social Science – Searching for True Love Social science includes various academic disciplines that study the functioning of human society and social relationships among individuals. Each social science subject offers a unique disciplinary perspective and involves knowledge and skills to decipher how society and individuals as part of society are intertwined. Beginning their academic journey in Social Science provides students with a broad base, which allows them to explore and learn more about the disciplines and how they interact. The curriculum design enables students to find their interests and paves the way for them to become social scientists, who can contribute to the well-being of individuals in society. Learning Path The Social Science Faculty’s broad-based admissions provide students with an option to explore their real interests in the field of Social Science. In the first year, students enrol in faculty package courses without committing to a particular major. From the second year onward, the students commit to one major Social Science programme to pursue a Bachelor of Social Science degree. Guidance and Flexibility The Faculty of Social Science is committed to helping broad-based students pursue their preferred major and to realize their aspirations by providing extensive counselling and advice. The curriculum is designed with great flexibility to allow completely free choice with no quota restrictions or competition among students. 12 Social Science Majors After realizing their potential and interests, students can declare any one of the following major programmes* and continue their studies in Years 2 to 4. Architectural Studies Economics Geography and Resource Management Government and Public Administration Journalism and Communication Psychology Sociology Urban Studies Data Science and Policy Studies Global Studies Global Communication Global Economics and Finance *Admission to specific programme(s) is subject to relevant conditions. If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted. APPLY NOW
